question: Can the supported channel-agnostic characteristic-slope result from P4AW be compiled into a deterministic, typed, amplitude-only 48-micrometre granularity profile without importing the rejected P5J channel coupling or inventing an NPS?

branch_rule.pass: Retain the amplitude-only profile as a research compiler input. A later separately frozen spatial normalizer may consume a generic or independently measured NPS shape while preserving this 48-micrometre amplitude; no photographic use opens here.
branch_rule.fail: Close the compiler without changing P4AW parameters, derivative semantics, domains or serialization.

forbidden: refit parameters on all points or on photographs
serialize the rejected P5J channel energy mapping
claim a measured NPS, grain radius, scanner response, particular roll/process or calibrated stock response
render photographs or alter product defaults
claim_ceiling: Deterministic amplitude-only compilation of one manufacturer-graph-compatible Kodak 250D diffuse-rms shape at a stated 48-micrometre aperture; not NPS, causal emulsion structure, roll/process/scanner calibration, stock response or product evidence.
